---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Denis Valle <privateem...@community.esa.org>
Date: Mon, Apr 11, 2022 at 10:42 AM
Subject: [Stats Ecology ESA] NIMBLE webinar
To: <Statistic...@community.esa.org>


Are you interested in Bayesian statistics? Come learn about NIMBLE with Dr. Lauren Ponisio!

The next seminar of our series is on Monday, April 18 and will be presented by Dr. Lauren Ponisio (University of Oregon)!

NIMBLE (short for Numerical Inference for statistical Models using Bayesian and Likelihood Estimation) is a system for building and sharing analysis methods in R for statistical models. It provides a flexible language for declaring a wide range of hierarchical models, a framework for defining algorithms that operate on this representation of models, and a compiler for generating equivalent C++.

EFI and the ESA Statistical Ecology Section are the hosts of the Statistical Methods Virtual Seminar Series. Speakers will spend 20 minutes presenting a project where they used a statistical method or tool followed by 40 minutes where they will share R code, describe pitfalls or stumbling blocks, and answer questions.

Topics, details, and registration links are here:
https://ecoforecast.org/workshops/statistical-methods-seminar-series/
